This checks the source's normalizer assignment with only 2 invertible, including characteristic three. title: The three-way correspondence survives with opposition retained
body: With 2 invertible, for a fixed étale form $X$ of a projective line, the valid correspondence is between Klein-four subgroup schemes, étale $\mathfrak S_4$-form subgroup schemes, and degree-six divisors equipped with a **regular fixed-point-free opposition**. From a Klein group take its axes; from an S4-form take its unique normal Klein group; from a regular opposition take its full direct combinatorial group, whose extension to $X$ is part of regularity. These constructions are inverse étale locally and descend, including in characteristic five. Thus the visible structured assertion of **Hua, findings register, 64-octahedral-configurations-relative** is supported, while the source's c)→b) formula must use the chosen structure's direct group when the full divisor stabilizer is larger.

section: C. Octahedral geometry: the valid theorem and its characteristic-five limit
title: The orientation cover is canonically μ4*, without choosing i
body: The margin identifies the orientation double cover with $\mu_4^*$, and this has a direct local construction: an orientation at a vertex selects a generator of its direct vertex stabilizer of order four, whose tangent multiplier is $i$ or $-i$. Direct transitivity makes that multiplier independent of the vertex, and reversing orientation inverts it, producing an isomorphism of double covers compatible with descent. This proves the structured orientation statement without requiring a global primitive fourth root. A projective automorphism preserving the chosen opposition is consequently direct, whereas in characteristic five a bare-divisor automorphism can change the opposition.
